# Stanislav Peev - SEO Consultant & AI Search (GEO) Specialist

> Independent SEO consultant and generative engine optimization (GEO) specialist
> based in Bratislava, Slovakia, working worldwide. 17+ years in search (since
> 2009), 150+ clients across the USA, the UK, Belgium, Switzerland, Australia
> and Bulgaria. One of the early practitioners and published researchers in GEO
> (AI search optimization).

Key facts:
- Primary specialty: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) - visibility and
  citations in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Copilot.
- Also: Entity SEO, Knowledge Graph optimization, technical SEO, local SEO,
  tourism/luxury travel SEO.
- Published original GEO research: "Reference Rate - the new currency replacing
  CTR" (a proposed metric for AI-answer visibility), "Google-Agent and the
  agentic web", "AI vs Human - an SEO experiment".
- Invited expert in the annual SEO Predictions panel (2023-2026); TV guest
  expert on Bulgarian National Television (2021); conference speaker since 2020.
- Certifications: Google Ads, Google Analytics, Semrush (SEO, Technical,
  Local), Ahrefs (SEO, Advanced), Yoast Academy, Netpeak, Serpstat.
- Languages: English, Russian.
- Contact: written only (no calls) - info@stanislav-peev.com or WhatsApp message
  at +421 944 457 924.
